rule: S_N must be unique across all records
rationale: S_N serves as a unique table-level identifier and one-to-one join key. Evidence confirms all 30 values are currently unique, and this must be maintained.

rule: Every S_N in Cust_Bio_dirty must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N
rationale: S_N is defined as a one-to-one shared join key with Acc_Info_dirty. Referential integrity must be enforced to ensure all customer records have corresponding account information.

rule: Account_No must not be null
rationale: Account_No is a mandatory business identifier for customer accounts. Evidence shows 0% missing values, confirming this is a required field.

rule: Account_No must be exactly 4 digits
rationale: Account numbers are 4-digit numeric codes ranging from 1001-1028. After conversion to the intended string type, values must maintain exactly 4 characters.

rule: Account_No must not be duplicated (flag for review)
rationale: Evidence identifies 2 duplicate account numbers (1001, 1010) appearing twice each. While these may represent valid joint accounts, they require verification to distinguish from data entry errors.

rule: Account_No must match the corresponding Account_No in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: Account_No should be consistent across the customer biography and account information tables for the same sequential number. Mismatches indicate data synchronization errors.

check_params.semantic_check: Account_No values must be identical between Cust_Bio_dirty and Acc_Info_dirty for matching S_N records

rule: Name must use Title Case format (flag all-lowercase or all-uppercase words)
rationale: Evidence shows 6.7% of values deviate from Title Case ('lim wei jie' all lowercase, 'WANG SHI JIE' all uppercase). Standard naming convention requires Title Case for all words except known lowercase particles (bin, binte, s/o, d/o).

check_params.logic: any((w.islower() or w.isupper()) and w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','s/o','d/o') and len(w) > 1 for w in str(row['Name']).split())

rule: Names containing 'Bin' or 's/o' must have Gender = 'Male'
rationale: Malay patronymic 'Bin' and Indian patronymic 's/o' (son of) indicate male gender. Records with these particles but Female gender represent semantic inconsistencies.

check_params.logic: (bool(re.search(r'(?<![a-z0-9])\ bin\ (?![a-z0-9])', str(str(row['Name'])).lower())) or bool(re.search(r'(?<![a-z0-9])\ s/o\ (?![a-z0-9])', str(str(row['Name'])).lower()))) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'male'

rule: Names containing 'Binte' or 'd/o' must have Gender = 'Female'
rationale: Malay patronymic 'Binte' and Indian patronymic 'd/o' (daughter of) indicate female gender. Records with these particles but Male gender represent semantic inconsistencies.

check_params.logic: (bool(re.search(r'(?<![a-z0-9])\ binte\ (?![a-z0-9])', str(str(row['Name'])).lower())) or bool(re.search(r'(?<![a-z0-9])\ d/o\ (?![a-z0-9])', str(str(row['Name'])).lower()))) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'female'

rule: Name must match Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N (accounting for standardization)
rationale: Customer name should be consistent across biographical and account tables. Discrepancies such as 'WANG SHI JIE' vs 'Wang Shi Jie' or 'Danish Bin Kamaruddin' vs 'Danish' indicate data quality issues.

check_params.semantic_check: Name must match Full_Name after normalizing case and whitespace for the same S_N

rule: ID_No must not be null
rationale: ID_No is a mandatory national identification field. Evidence shows 0% missing values across 30 records.

rule: ID_No must follow Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S, T, F, or G), followed by 7 digits, ending with one uppercase letter
rationale: 93.3% of values conform to the standard 9-character format (e.g., S8403757E). Deviations including missing prefix letters ('1916569C') or incorrect digit count ('F212233V') must be flagged.

rule: ID_No must exactly match ID in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: National identification numbers must be identical across linked tables. Evidence shows a mismatch (S8421753J vs S8421753X) indicating potential data entry or synchronization errors.

check_params.semantic_check: ID_No must exactly match the corresponding ID value in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N

rule: Race must be one of: Chinese, Indian, Malay
rationale: Evidence shows 6 distinct values representing 3 categories with inconsistent casing (MALAY, malay, indian). Values must conform to the standardized canonical set.

rule: Race must not be null
rationale: Race is a mandatory demographic field with 0% missing values in the dataset.

rule: Gender must be either Male or Female
rationale: Evidence shows 4 distinct values due to casing variations (male, FEMALE). Must be standardized to Title Case canonical values.

rule: Gender must not be null
rationale: Gender is a mandatory demographic field with 100% population in the dataset.

rule: Age must be numeric (parseable as number)
rationale: Column is stored as int64 but contains non-numeric text value 'Twenty-five' (3.3% of records). All values must be parseable as numeric.

rule: Age must be between 0 and 120 inclusive
rationale: Age represents human lifespan. Evidence shows values -5 and 4 which are below realistic thresholds for service accounts, and maximum of 66. Domain constraint requires 0-120 range.

rule: Age must not be null
rationale: Age is a mandatory demographic field with 0% missing values in the current dataset.

rule: Contact_No must not be null
rationale: Evidence shows 6.7% missing values (2 NULL records). Contact numbers are mandatory for customer communication and verification.

rule: Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number (8 digits, optionally prefixed with +65 or 65)
rationale: Evidence shows inconsistent formatting and one 7-digit anomalous value ('8964359'). Valid Singapore numbers are 8 digits starting with 6, 8, or 9, with optional +65/65 prefix.

rule: Email must not be null
rationale: Email is a mandatory contact field with 100% population in the dataset.

rule: Email must contain exactly one @ symbol with no whitespace
rationale: Evidence identifies 4 structurally malformed emails (13.3%): missing @ ('not-an-email', 'useremail.com'), embedded space ('zx91 @example.com'), and double @ ('nabilah@@example.com').

rule: Country must be 'Singapore'
rationale: Evidence shows 8 variations of Singapore (Singapore, SINGAPORE, singapore, S'pore, Singapura, SG, Republic of Singapore, 新加坡). Must be standardized to the official English short form 'Singapore'.

rule: Country must not be null
rationale: Country is a mandatory address field with 0% missing values.

rule: Street_Name must not be in all uppercase
rationale: Evidence shows one value 'HOLLAND ROAD' in all caps (3.3%) while 29 values use Title Case. Standard format requires Title Case.

rule: Street_Name must not be null
rationale: Street name is a mandatory address component with 100% population.

rule: Postal_Code must not be null
rationale: Postal code is mandatory for address completeness with 0% missing values.

rule: Postal_Code must be exactly 6 digits
rationale: Singapore postal codes are strictly 6 digits. Evidence shows variations with 4 digits ('6907') and 5 digits ('99999'), indicating missing leading zeros or invalid codes. After conversion to string, must be 6 characters.
